description: Main FastAPI application for contract analysis API, including endpoints for health check, contract upload, listing, and detail retrieval. It integrates PDF text extraction, OpenAI analysis, and in-memory data storage.

classes.name: AnalysisResponse
classes.description: Response model for an analyzed contract.

classes.name: ContractSummary
classes.description: Lightweight summary returned in contract listings.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Return a simple health status message.

methods.description: Retrieve detailed contract data by ID.

methods.name: upload_and_analyze_contract(file: UploadFile = File(...), token: Optional[str] = Depends(supabase_jwt_validator))
methods.description: Handle contract PDF uploads, extract text, analyze with OpenAI, and store results.

methods.name: Optional[str] supabase_jwt_validator(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Lightweight stub for JWT validation, extracting Bearer token.
